resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR says constructed in 1967; firelookout.com and the July 2026 Oregon list say 1965. Both years are kept as separate built events and the story reports both without choosing.
NHLR says 107-foot Aermotor with metal cab; firelookout.com says 90-foot steel tower with 7x7 cab. The height fact uses NHLR's figure and the story flags the disagreement.

sources.title: Oregon's Standing Lookouts - Every Lookout in Oregon

notes_for_editor: Same site under two names: NHLR says Sidwalter Mountain Lookout, firelookout.com and the Oregon lists say Sidwalter Butte; coordinates match (44.914, -121.533). Build year (1965 vs 1967) and design (107 ft Aermotor vs 90 ft steel) disagree and are reported as such. No sourced account of fires, keepers or the lookout's staffing history was found in the reads. Staffing 'staffed' comes from the July 2026 list only. Access is closed to the public per NHLR; the record's permission level is proposed as closed. The record's height_m 2.1 is an error and is proposed as 32.6.
